verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents an official MCP server hosted at https://app.puzzle.io/mcp, with a setup guide for connecting Claude. The guide lists the exposed ledger tools, including trial balance, transactions, journal entries, invoices and bills. Beta write access confirms each change with the user, and a separate article says ChatGPT and other assistants can connect through the Puzzle MCP. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP connection, and write access is still Beta.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Puzzle's MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration lets you connect your Puzzle account directly to Claude, giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation
ask Claude, ChatGPT or another AI assistant through the Puzzle MCP
